title: Clean-call machine
statement: Given a finite Boolean Turing machine $M$ and a Boolean flag $e$, the clean-call machine has the prepared source machine's work tapes and a control state that combines its source states with states for clearing each source tape and for finalizing the result. It begins by simulating the prepared source phase; it then runs the interval cleaner on the source tapes in turn, and finally runs the two-tape result finalizer, whose behavior is selected by $e$.
